summary: SDKs need to implement conflict token retry logic for schedule updates. They must pass the conflict token from DescribeSchedule to UpdateSchedule requests and retry the describe-modify-update loop when the server returns a FailedPrecondition error for mismatched conflict tokens.
userImpact: Users cannot reliably update schedules in concurrent scenarios without manually implementing conflict token retry logic.
rootCause: Server now enforces conflict tokens for schedule updates (via temporal/temporal#8474), but no SDK implements the required retry loop.
proposedFix: Pass the conflict token from DescribeSchedule in UpdateSchedule requests and retry the describe-modify-update loop on FailedPrecondition with mismatched conflict token errors.
keyQuote: Retry the describe-modify-update loop on FailedPrecondition with "mismatched conflict token"
